resources.string: Restore the default POCO desktop page when HOME is used.

Version %1$s

Install the module APK, enable it in Vector/LSPosed, and select only POCO Launcher (com.mi.android.globallauncher) as its scope. Reboot, then open this settings screen once to initialize the preferences shared with the launcher.

Analysis target: POCO F8 Ultra (myron), Android 16 / HyperOS 3, POCO Launcher RELEASE-7.50.06.2592-09011644. Physical-device behavior has not been verified. Other launcher builds are disabled automatically.

Changes apply on the next HOME action. Diagnostic logging can be disabled above. To recover from a problem, disable this module in Vector/LSPosed and reboot.
